/**
 * Whether a digit string satisfies the Luhn check.
 */
export function isValidLuhn(value: string): boolean {
	if (!/^[0-9]{2,19}$/u.test(value)) {
		return false;
	}
	let sum: number = 0;
	const scalars: readonly number[] = Array.from(value, (scalar) => scalar.codePointAt(0)!);
	for (let index = 0; index < scalars.length; index++) {
		const digit: number = ((scalars[index] ?? 48) - 48);
		const doubled: boolean = (((scalars.length - index) % 2) === 0);
		const weighted: number = (doubled ? (digit * 2) : digit);
		sum = (sum + ((weighted > 9) ? (weighted - 9) : weighted));
	}
	return ((sum % 10) === 0);
}
